lines: Now, in ripened impurity: what shape has the descent, and what marks it?
By this the difference-doctrine counters collapse — dispassion, special-duty, discernment, true-service, true-attainment, god-worship, and the rest as reasons.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atha malaparipāke śaktipātaḥ so 'pi kiṃsvarūpaḥ kiṃ ca tasya nimittam iti etena vairāgyaṃ dharmaviśeṣo vivekaḥ satsevā satprāptiḥ devapūjā ityādihetuḥ pratyukta iti bhedavādināṃ sarvam asamañjasam
